decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression, explains busy is local to AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, and describes the occurrence/plain-phase trigger.
Explains the render ReferenceError is caught by the slot boundary, removing the whole dock entry while the separate attach-button slot survives with console-only diagnostics.
Discusses the shipped baseline expression, the inconsistent diff evidence, rollback/re-add or data-present mount isolation, and the added imageItem scoping defect.
Recommends removing or properly owning busy, preserving the phase guard, hardening record items and DOM closest access, and scoping hover lookups inside the map callback.
Proposes a plain-phase data-present render smoke asserting chip/remove control and no boundary capture, and explains why empty tests and node --check miss this.
